claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Cinalukast is a cysteinyl leukotriene receptor antagonist with no known cytotoxic pharmacophore; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen, with any weak killing attributable to nonspecific physicochemical effects rather than a defined mechanism class.
